title: Effects of scarification, gibberellic acid and dry heat treatments on the germination of Balanites aegyptiaca seeds from the Sudanian savanna in Burkina Faso
why: Abstract opened: 'Neither scarification nor gibberellic acid treatments resulted in significantly higher germination than the control.'
